document.about: Kohler K-R33912 kitchen faucet specification sheet (3 pages, printed by Chrome). The first page opens on a title block; the two after it run the same two lines small at their top right.

notes: #115: page 3's heading and the bullets under the faucet's dimension drawing were typed doco:Figure: the heading because the box around the drawing's labels stretched over it, the bullets as labels within the drawing's reach. The third bullet, past the size bound, stayed a paragraph.

checks.issue: `Installation`, set as `Installation Notes` is, was typed as the drawing's label.
The first two bullets under the drawing were typed as its labels; the third, run on from them, was not.

element.text: Installs with 1- or 3-hole sink (escutcheon plate included)
